expected_value_creation: Organizations can authorize a policy activation only from sufficient preview evidence, observe a bounded rollout, and prove why continuation, abort, or rollback occurred.
supporting_evidence: v0.8.6 provides frozen scope and deterministic census but explicitly excludes activation and rollback.
Current governance guidance emphasizes scoped authorization, continuous evaluation, circuit breakers, and rollback.
success_criteria: Every activation decision references one sufficient rollout preview and accountable authority.
Every activation has a bounded observation contract with signals, thresholds, deadline, stop conditions, and rollback target.
Adverse, missing, or stale evidence deterministically blocks continuation or requires rollback and governance.
